description: This file defines a report for item price stock in an ERP system, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data, and map prices.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches report data based on filters and columns.

methods.name: get_item_price_qty_data
methods.description: Retrieves item price and stock quantity data, optionally filtered by item code.

methods.name: get_price_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of item prices for buying or selling prices based on price list names.
